about: Netball Unleashed: the owner's notes, each a test for good (tools/wsg/owner_notes.gd runs them; CI with WSG_NOTES_STRICT=1). Never remove one: tools/wsg/owner_notes_guard.sh fails CI if an id once here is gone. Notes written ahead of their fix wait in pending/ (not in the strict run).

notes.words: On Menu make the black line white between nations cup and club season
Use the running .FBX from the other games in development, the running with the arms out looks awkward.
the near side's crowd looked the wrong way
failure conflict
Licenses/Help/Privacy links returned 404
Netball is still severely broken: players gliding around, not running, arms just stretched out when running. Looks like nothing was updated.
When switching to a camera angle that is not alongside the court, the joystick movement is all wrong.
Watch AI
When there is contact and advantage have the defending player move out of the way.

Look at all maps/arenas that have different standing/sitting and make sure the crowd is sitting properly (body not standing awkwardly inside the seat), watching the game properly, facing the right direction, standing properly.
The crowd isn't real people, why isn't that updated? That was supposed to be shared foundation too. Even on High in the outdoor court the crowd looks like simple shapes.
Most of the crowd is still just squares, needs to be actual people.
Players floating around and not moving legs, thought that was fixed in shared foundation.
Often times their hands aren't holding the ball, it looks like the forearms are holding the ball.
In the how to play positions section the court graphics don't show the positions, its just the same image over and over.
When you click start game there is a loading delay … long enough on the slow phone that users might think the game has frozen. We either need a little load screen or load bar by the start buttons.
Net still isn't moving when ball hits it.
The net should move when the ball goes in, it's rope and should sway.
The pass speed doesn't look very natural, the lobs especially. Check the physics of the ball movement.
Some times the passes are almost across the court and they just keep going, that seems unlikely. Like it will never succumb to gravity.
During penalties or obstructions the defender is almost on top of the passer, change that if its not realistic.
The referees look too much like block figures, not humans.
Their stance is too rigid when not moving, it doesn't look natural with their hands out and not moving.
There are times when a player is shooting that the woman is facing the wrong direction and not at the hoop.
